headline: Did AZ Chike deliver on the wait for his project? What did you think of the album and what
body: Did AZ Chike deliver on the wait for his project? What did you think of the album and what was your favorite song? “No Rest For The Wicked” included some big name producers and two features from Tyler, The Creator @feliciathegoat but says Chike stood his own and showcased why he will be around for a long time with this album.
